name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Stand with the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell to chest height.
Let it swing back between your legs and repeat.
cue: Hinge, then snap the hips forward
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging at the hips.
Using the arms to lift instead of the hip drive.
